title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is equal to the product of all the elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`. The product of any prefix or suffix of `nums` is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time and without using the division operation.

hints.content: Can you precompute prefix products and suffix products?
Prefix product up to i gives product of all elements to the left.
First pass computes left prefix products. Second pass iterates backwards accumulating right suffix products.

solution.explanation:
Calculate prefix products from left to right, then multiply by running suffix products from right to left.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(1) extra space excluding output array
